title: Pydantic schema contracts
objective: Freeze the data contracts every later module consumes: AssetInput, IngestRequest, ScanResult, ClearanceCertificate, EvidenceRecord.
agent_steps: Implement the five models in src/traceai/core/models.py exactly as specified in the build guide.
Add strict validation: mime allowlist, hash format sha256:<64 hex>, score ranges 0..1.
Write contract tests covering valid, boundary, and rejected payloads.
Export the OpenAPI schema artifact for the UI team.
acceptance_criteria: All five models import cleanly and serialize round-trip to JSON.
Invalid license enums, malformed hashes, and out-of-range scores raise ValidationError.
Contract tests pass and OpenAPI exports without error.
